verdict.rationale: GitLab clearly ships CI/CD ("Build and test your application"), and its cluster integration offers one-click install of GitLab Runner into your own cluster, so self-managed runners are documented. A community report about "CI workers... even self-hosted ones" corroborates that both hosted and self-hosted runners exist; its reliability complaint concerns performance, not whether the capability exists. Multi-project CI/CD management via API hints at central control, but there is no first-party documentation of platform-hosted runners or a central runner/pipeline view. Missing for 10: explicit docs on GitLab-hosted runners, documented runner registration and management across groups and instances, centralized pipeline/runner visibility dashboards, independent hands-on corroboration.
